# Thompho’s Driving Academy Knowledge Base

## About Thompho’s Driving Academy

Thompho’s Driving Academy is a driving school in Sunnyside, Pretoria. It helps learners gain confidence behind the wheel through structured lessons, patient instructors, and support from booking through to test preparation. Services: beginner driving lessons, K53 test preparation, learner confidence building, refresher lessons, parking and road skills, and driving test readiness.

Address: 81 Celliers St, Sunnyside, Pretoria, 0002 (Adverto Tower).
Phone: 012 772 1616. WhatsApp: +27 64 681 4176.

The website also provides a free public K53 guide, exam-style practice tests, road-sign and road-rule study notes, study videos, a testing-centre search and a paid full-access package for the online practice tests.

## Free K53 learner's licence study guide

Page: /k53-learners-study-guide

- The learner's licence test has three separately scored sections: Rules of the Road (28 questions, minimum 22), Road Traffic Signs (28 questions, minimum 23) and Vehicle Controls (8 questions, minimum 6).
- Candidates must pass all three sections.
- Official learner's licence categories are Code 1 (motorcycles), Code 2 (light motor vehicles) and Code 3 (heavy motor vehicles). Code 8, Code 10 and Code 14 are familiar driving-licence terms; confirm the official learner category with your Driving Licence Testing Centre (DLTC) when booking.
- A learner's licence is valid for 24 months and cannot be extended.
- Original PDF summary: /downloads/thompho-free-k53-learners-study-guide.pdf
